verdicts.evidence: c3ref: 'The busy-handler callback is never invoked in the SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_PASSIVE mode... might leave the checkpoint unfinished if there are concurrent readers or writers.'

verdicts.claim: FULL waits (via the busy handler) until there is no writer and all readers see the latest snapshot... TRUNCATE is RESTART plus trunc

verdicts.evidence: c3ref: 'All calls obtain an exclusive "checkpoint" lock... SQLITE_BUSY is returned. Even if there is a busy-handler configured, it will not be invoked'; 'FULL, RESTART and TRUNCATE modes also obtain the exclusive "writer" lock'.

verdicts.evidence: wal.html: 'read performance deteriorates as the WAL file grows'; 'this strategy seems to work well in test applications on workstations'.
